description: Submit a DataFrame of prompts to OpenAI's async Batch API (~50% cheaper than synchronous chat completions). Content-addressed idempotency: retries/re-runs with unchanged prompts reattach to the existing batch instead of resubmitting. wait_for_completion=False (default) returns immediately with a small manifest -- no worker blocks waiting; pair with openai_batch_status_sensor + openai_batch_results.

outputs.description: Small manifest (batch_id/status/request_count), or the full parsed results DataFrame when wait_for_completion=True

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of prompts.

prompt_column.label: Prompt Column
prompt_column.description: Column holding the raw text to send as the user message. Mutually exclusive with prompt_template.

prompt_template.label: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: Format-string template using row values, e.g. "Summarize: {body}". Rendered per row via str.format(**row_dict). Mutually exclusive with prompt_column.

id_column.label: ID Column
id_column.description: Column to use as each row's custom_id in the batch request. If unset, the row's positional index (as a string) is used.

model.label: Model
model.description: OpenAI model id used in each batch request's body.

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System message prepended to each request.

completion_window.label: Completion Window
completion_window.description: OpenAI batch completion window. Currently '24h' is the only value OpenAI accepts, but this stays a field for forward-compat.

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: If True, poll synchronously until the batch reaches a terminal state and return the fully parsed output DataFrame directly (blocking, 'give me everything now' mode). If False (default), return immediately after submit/reattach with a small manifest (batch_id/status/request_count) -- no worker blocks waiting; the paired openai_batch_status_sensor + openai_batch_results components fetch results later.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls. Only used when wait_for_completion=True.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a terminal state before raising. Only used when wait_for_completion=True.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the OpenAI API key.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'support', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog, e.g. ['openai', 'llm']. Defaults to ['openai', 'llm'] if not set.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
